description: DEF CON 32 Policy Village brings together hackers, policymakers, legal scholars, and government officials to explore cybersecurity legislation, regulation, and digital rights. Sessions focus on vulnerability disclosure policies, national cyber strategy, privacy protections, and the legal implications of emerging technologies.

talks.title: Policy Preview
talks.teaser: Previews the schedule, major themes, and community events featured at DEF CON 32 Policy Village.
talks.summary:
In this preview for DEF CON 32, Harley Geiger of the DEF CON Policy Department invites the community to explore the Policy Village and highlights the critical convergence of hacker technical expertise and public policy. At 00:15, he outlines how the Policy Department acts as a vital bridge between grassroots security researchers and government leadership, including delegates from the White House, Congress, and cybersecurity agencies such as CISA and the Office of the National Cyber Director (ONCD).

At 01:00, Harley previews major policy themes addressed across interactive workshops, panels, and presentations. Key topics include securing critical infrastructure against nation-state threats, navigating over 50 overlapping federal cyber incident reporting requirements, and coordinating effective vulnerability disclosure. At 01:45, he highlights discussions on artificial intelligence—examining malicious attacks against AI, leveraging AI for proactive defense, and evaluating model integrity through independent red teaming, bug bounties, and bias bounties.
